newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Knightsbridge Tankers obtains five VLCC charters.
newsitem.headline: Knightsbridge Tankers obtains five VLCC charters.

text.p: Swedish shipping company Knightsbridge Tankers Ltd said on Tuesday it had received five double hulled VLCCs, each totalling 298,000 tonnes.

The tankers, built by South Korea's Daewoo Heavy Industries in 1995 and 1996, would be leased to Shell for seven to 14 years starting from their delivery date, Knightsbridge Tankers said in a statement.
"Knightsbridge will receive a charter fee which corresponds to income of VLCCs on the spot market or a minimum fee if one is more advantageous," Knightsbridge said.
Knightsbridge Tankers, listed on Nasdaq, is managed by Stockholm listed ICB Shipping. ICB Shipping is Knightsbridge's largest owner.
